typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	ArchiveFile as string (),
	ArchivePath as string (),
	DBPassword as string (),
	DBServerName as string (),
	EmailRecipients as string (),
	ErrorEmailRecipients as string (),
	FileName as string (),
	File_Exists_Fl as string (),
	ImportFile as string (),
	ImportPath as string (),
	InitialCatalog as string (),
	NoFileEmailRecipients as string (),
	RecordsInSrcFile as integer (),
	UserName as string ()
}

source(output(
		FileProcessedDtm as string,
		McoName as string,
		MCONumber as string,
		MedicaidID as string,
		MedicaidDSNPPeriod as string,
		FirstName as string,
		LastName as string,
		DateOfBirth as string,
		MBI as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	ignoreNoFilesFound: false) ~> MCOMEMBERLIST
MCOMEMBERLIST derive({Copy of DateOfBirth} = DateOfBirth,
		{Copy of MedicaidDSNPPeriod} = MedicaidDSNPPeriod,
		{Copy of MedicaidID} = MedicaidID,
		{Copy of MBI} = MBI,
		{Copy of FileProcessedDtm} = FileProcessedDtm,
		{Copy of McoName} = McoName,
		{Copy of FirstName} = FirstName,
		{Copy of LastName} = LastName,
		{Copy of MCONumber} = MCONumber) ~> DataConversion
DataConversion derive(CREATE_DATE = currentTimestamp()) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		DateOfBirth as string,
		CREATE_DATE as timestamp 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		MedicaidID as string,
		McoName as string,
		MBI as string,
		FirstName as string,
		FileProcessedDtm as string,
		LastName as string,
		MCONumber as string,
		MedicaidDSNPPeriod as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		DateOfBirth = {Copy of DateOfBirth},
		CREATE_DATE,
		MedicaidID = {Copy of MedicaidID},
		McoName = {Copy of McoName},
		MBI = {Copy of MBI},
		FirstName = {Copy of FirstName},
		FileProcessedDtm = {Copy of FileProcessedDtm},
		LastName = {Copy of LastName},
		MCONumber = {Copy of MCONumber},
		MedicaidDSNPPeriod = {Copy of MedicaidDSNPPeriod})) ~> MCOMEMBERLISTSTG
